name: Hasselback Potatoes
desc: Accordion-cut russets roasted with butter and olive oil, then loaded with cheddar, bacon, and sour cream.

source.title: Hasselback Potatoes
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (6 russets, 1/4 cup each oil and butter, 8 slices thin-cut cheddar in 1-inch squares, 4 slices bacon, 1/3 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp green onions), 450°F and 50 to 60 minutes.

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste
8 slices thin-cut cheddar cheese, cut into 1-inch squares
4 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled

steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and coat the foil with cooking spray.

Lay a potato between two chopsticks on a cutting board and slice it crosswise 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick; the chopsticks stop the knife before it cuts all the way through. Repeat with the rest and set them on the pan.
Whisk the olive oil, butter, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Brush it all over the potatoes, working some between the slices.
Bake until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife and browned, 50 to 60 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.
Tuck the cheese squares between the slices. Return to the oven until the cheese melts, 3 to 5 minutes.
Top each potato with a spoonful of sour cream, the bacon, and the green onions. Serve right away.
